name: cardiac_axis_vector_projection
mechanism: Replaces independent lead amplitude generation with a 2D frontal plane vector projection model that calculates lead-specific amplitudes based on intrinsic wave magnitudes and randomized cardiac axis angles.

name: proportional_t_wave_scaling
mechanism: Scale T-wave timing and width proportionally to the dynamic QT interval rather than using fixed time offsets to maintain realistic morphology across varying heart rates.

name: randomized_pr_interval
mechanism: Replaced a fixed P-wave time offset with a uniformly sampled PR interval to introduce physiological temporal variability.

name: dynamic_twave_interval_scaling
mechanism: Calculates T-wave temporal centers and widths as proportional fractions of the dynamic QT interval to ensure smooth physiological continuity across the ST segment.
